title: Revisit Capybara workaround
summary: In https://github.com/UCNRS-RAMS/ucnrs-rams/pull/1266 we hit a Capybara issue that required us to implement a temporary workaround. This issue is to revisit that workaround and put us back to our regular setup for Capybara once they fix it and create a release.

title: Dropping a collection can be too tedious.
summary: If have to drop a lot of collection, the confirmation demanding to type the whole name everytime takes too much time. An option should be available in the settings: _Dropping confirmation: slow/quick_ (default=slow) _(if "Quick", you just have to confirm with single click.)_ _(if "Slow", you must type the name of the collection in order to drop it.)_
